description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and constants related to grain interface properties in the Orleans framework. It includes the GrainInterfaceProperties class for managing interface property data, well-known property keys, provider interfaces, and an attribute for specifying default grain types.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Immutable class representing properties of a grain interface, with methods for initialization and detailed string representation.

classes.name: WellKnownGrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Static class containing constant keys for well-known grain interface properties such as version, default grain type, and type name.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Interface for classes that provide grain interface properties, with a method to populate properties based on interface type and grain type.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attribute classes that add grain interface properties, used by attribute-based providers.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider that gathers properties from attributes on interface types.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: Attribute specifying the default grain type for an interface, implementing the provider attribute interface.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the GrainInterfaceProperties instance.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method in provider interfaces to add properties based on interface type, grain type, or service provider.

methods.name: DefaultGrainTypeAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute with a specified grain type.
